from workflow import Session

class Env:
    def __init__(self): self.listeners={}; self.pending=[]; self.audit=[]; self.visible=[]; self.queue=[]
    def bind(self, f): return f
    def call(self, method, *args):
        a=args[0] if args else None
        if method == 'listen': self.listeners.setdefault(a,[]).append(args[1]); return args[1]
        if method == 'unlisten': self.listeners[a].remove(args[1]); return None
        if method == 'start': return None
        if method == 'decode': self.pending.append(args[2]); return {'deferred': True}
        if method == 'recordProgress': self.audit.append(a); return None
        if method == 'showProgress': self.visible.append(a); return None
        if method == 'record': self.queue.append(a); return None
        if method in ('transport','cancel','showQueued'): return None
        raise AssertionError(method)
